The compliance pre-check examines three areas before a campaign reaches VP review:

**1. Brand Alignment** — Scans your campaign copy against the banned words list in BRAND-GL-2026-001 (terms like "cheap," "last chance," "clearance blowout," and "unbeatable" are prohibited). It also checks whether your tagline is on the pre-approved tagline list (currently: "The Magic of Macys," "Find Your Magic," "Star Rewards, Every Day," and "New In Store, New Online"). Any tagline not on the list requires Brand Marketing Council review.

**2. Disclaimers** — Verifies that pricing claims follow FTC and internal legal requirements. Per LEGAL-DIS-2026-002, any "up to X percent off" claim must include the minimum discount available (e.g., "Up to 25 percent off, starting at 10 percent off"). It also checks for proper compare-at pricing disclaimers and financing disclosure language.

**3. Pricing Cross-Check** — Runs the selected SKUs against the MAP-enforced brand list in PRICE-RULES-2026-001. Brands like Lancome, Estee Lauder, Clinique, La Mer, Dior Beauty, Coach, Levi's, and Tag Heuer have minimum advertised price restrictions. Any proposed discount on these brands requires written Merchandising approval. Violating MAP can result in vendor charge-backs.

For your Mother's Day Beauty Event specifically, the main things to watch are the tagline ("Beauty She Deserves" is not on the pre-approved list) and ensuring your "Up to 25% off" copy includes the starting-at minimum. You can reference past flags in COMP-EX-2026-001 for examples of how similar issues were resolved.
